name: Kumada Kaena
source:
A nurse who always has a kind look on her face and a soft-spoken demeanor. However, although she usually hides it (sometimes shee can't hide it), she is the one with the most sexual desire in the series, and is also a sex toy collector. She also lends it to the protagonist and uses it with him.

Shee is very obedient to the main character and has a masochistic temperament, and her tolerance level is much deeper than that of a normal person. Even when something unexpected happens, she easily accepts it. 

Her breats are second to Nurse Manami Naga, and her body is also good. She has a soft, slightly laid-back vibe overall.
